## Study with SEEM at KFUPM

Prospective students interested in SEEM's research can join KFUPM through the university's official study pathways:

- [Undergraduate admission](https://admissions.kfupm.edu.sa/en)
- [Research-based master's and PhD study](https://kfupm.edu.sa/study/master-of-science-thesis-based-phd)

## How to find us

SEEM is based at the [College of Petroleum Engineering & Geosciences](https://cpg.kfupm.edu.sa/) in Building 76 on the KFUPM campus in Dhahran, KSA.
